sense.text:
Job was a black man. In the old icons he sits on the floor with the light of understanding around his head, his black wife standing behind him with her head wrapped, and his three black friends sitting with him talking. The scripture says it plainly: “My skin is black upon me.” Black man, three black friends, black wife.

These are the images Esau did not get to whitewash. When our people ruled in Russia, the last place we held a stronghold of authority, as czars, bishops and kings, we painted the prophets, the disciples and Christ the biblical way: black. The Last Supper with twelve black men, Judas dipping his black, treacherous hand in the dish, Christ washing black feet, Hananiah, Azariah and Mishael black in the fiery furnace with a black angel watching over them, Peter with an afro, King David, Aaron, Daniel, black like his brothers.

Outside America they know the Israelites are black: Germany knows, Russia knows, they worship a black Mary over there and Christ is black. They keep it secret here because the prophets, the princes, the children of David, Aaron and Jonathan, are here. We don’t care about color, but our people have been brainwashed to think everything that is God, angels, prophets and disciples is white. White angels, a white God, a white Adam, white prophets: that is racial idolatry, not black folks saying Israel.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”: Esau took over in the Renaissance. Renaissance means rebirth: the rebirth of the European powers rising up and taking over the earth once again, before as the Greeks and Romans, and now as the European Union, America included. It was the revival of classical antiquity, the interwoven civilizations of ancient Greece and Rome, the Greco Roman world. It began in Italy, in Rome, and that is no accident, because it is the revival of Rome; then it spread throughout Europe, to England, France, the Dutch.

Its foundation was humanism, set up by a small elite, the upper echelon who rule behind the scenes, who had access to books that black folks were not allowed to have, as a program to revive the culture, literature and moral philosophy of the Greco Roman civilization and to influence all of society. Man is the measure of all things: the humanist disregards the Bible and believes his own mind and feelings, and it led to atheism too. Most humanists were Christians, and their concern was to purify and renew Christianity: to whitewash it and put it in their own image. That is the Christianity many of our people follow today. The Trinity, three who are one, spiritual Israel, Calvinism’s faith only with no works, once saved always saved, the revised Bibles, Pentecostal, Baptist, Methodist, Jehovah Witness: Greco Roman ideology merged with the Bible. And that is what Christmas is based upon.

Western culture, the culture we live in in America, is the classical culture of ancient Greece and Rome and their Christian successors, the Catholic Church that destroyed and conquered us throughout Europe, carried around the world by colonization, war and conquest. Its customs, its belief systems, its politics, Democrat and Republican, liberal and conservative, even its technology: all Greco Roman. America is an extension of the Greco Roman Empire.

Before the Renaissance, black people ruled Europe. The dark ages were when dark people ruled, but we ruled while in spiritual darkness ourselves, upholding Greco Roman ideology, so it was only a temporary rule. We lost land by land, city by city, country by country: the Byzantine Empire fell on May 14th 1453, then the Moors, then Germany, and lastly Russia. As we fell, Esau began to rise and regain power and authority on the earth.

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof.” We were the judges, and he whitewashed our faces. Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo whitewashed Jesus Christ: the white Christ our people love is Cesare Borgia, son of Pope Alexander VI, Rodrigo Borgia, who posed for it. It is an open secret among the elite, esoteric knowledge few know. The bust was found in a church near Rome, the church destroyed but the bust saved: the crown of thorns, the long stringy hair, your white Jesus. The God of the Sistine Chapel touching fingers with a naked Adam is Rodrigo Borgia given a beard. Naked babies flying around, a Last Supper full of women, white angels killing a black devil with an afro: that is Renaissance art, the art changed into the Greco Roman image. That self hatred and degenerate mindset in our people came from this.

When we ruled, we painted our forefathers and foremothers and the prophets in our image, because that is how they looked. In one old image a painter is shown painting over the black image: that is iconoclasm, image destruction, whitewashing. Even the book of icons says the frescoes and wall mosaics have emerged from layers of whitewash. You can’t whitewash white; you whitewash black. They painted over the black images, but they couldn’t get them all. There were too many.

“If not, where, and who is he?” If he didn’t do it, who did? Did the Asians whitewash the image of Christ? Did the Arabs? No. The so-called white men covered the faces of the judges.

precepts.why:
This is nothing new. Israel “laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” The heathen there were the Greeks: they sought to paint the likeness of their images in our books, in our Bibles.

The Greeks did then exactly what the Renaissance does now, because the Renaissance is the revival of Greco Roman culture. Covering the faces of the judges, whitewashing our images and putting their own likeness in their place, is an old work of the same people.

sense.text: “I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us?” Israel asks it because we were in constant captivity: where did you love us? “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob”: God loved Jacob, our father.

“And I hated Esau”: Esau, the progenitor of the so-called white man today. “And laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness”: God had him displaced out of his land, and he ended up in the Caucasus Mountains.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished”: we’re low now, on the bottom. “But we will return and build the desolate places”: we will return, we will revive. That is the Renaissance, the rebirth: Edom building up Europe to become a superpower on the earth.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”: they will rise again, but God himself will throw them down. “And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”: this nation is the border, the beginning and the end of all wickedness on the earth. “And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever”: not Esau alone, but his people, his progeny. The Lord will hate them forever.

precepts.why:
“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: God says to Edom, “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” They hated it. “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” Edom gained power on the earth when he rose again, and in his pride he thinks no one can bring him down. He is the one who dwells in the clefts of the rocks, in the mountains: cave dwellers, Caucasians, troglodytes.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: Greece, Rome, Spain and Portugal all rose up as the eagle, and America rose up as the eagle. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: gaining power out in space, space travel. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.”

It is the same thing God said in Malachi: “They shall build, but I will throw down.” Edom will rise up in power in the Renaissance, but God will bring him down.

sense.text: “A beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns”: the fourth beast Daniel saw, going into Rome. “And upon his horns ten crowns”: the European Union. “And upon his heads the name of blasphemy”: names that mean lies.

“The beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”: that goes into the Greeks. “And his feet were as the feet of a bear”: he adopted Persian culture as well. “And his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: Babylonian. His holidays and customs, New Year’s and Christmas, are Babylonian in origin.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.” The dragon is the devil. That is why Edom says in Obadiah, who shall bring me down to the ground: Satan gave him authority. How did he go to the stars? Satan gave him the power to do it: space travel, rocket science, nuclear bombs.

“I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: one of the seven heads was Rome. Our people conquered Rome under Septimius Severus in 193 AD and took over, so Rome was not fully conquered, only wounded, because black folks ruled it temporarily. Once we fell, they revived that head: “and his deadly wound was healed.” That healing is the Renaissance. “And all the world wondered after the beast”: the Europeans, the beast.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”: they worshipped Satan and gave their power and their will to him. It’s all Edom anyway. “Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” He gained power and authority on the earth and became a superpower.
“A mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”: against God and against his people. “And power was given unto him to continue”: power to rule over us.

“He opened his mouth in blasphemy against God”: once he gained authority and power on the earth he began to say there is no God. Humanism, secularism, what they call the age of enlightenment: no more need for the Bible, only the wisdom of man, man the measure.

“To blaspheme his name”: that goes into us, the Israelites. America and the EU helped those over there into the land and said those are the Jews. That is blaspheming his name: they are not the Israelites, they are Israelis. “And them that dwell in heaven”: saying God is white, Christ is white, the angels are white, the prophets are white. That is blaspheming the things in heaven.

“It was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: they made war with us and conquered us through the Middle Ages, in Spain, Portugal, France and Italy, and eventually Russia, Germany and Britain, and in the Americas, and enslaved us. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: power from Satan.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”: every nation on the earth reverences, admires and worships Esau, religiously, politically, financially and philosophically. He is the god of this world, and so is his father Satan; wherever he says, it goes, and black folks hold his words to the skies.

The ones who worship him are those “whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.” That goes for the nations and for wicked Israelites: they are not found in that book, and they will die, stay dead and be dead forever.

“I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this beast is America. “And he had two horns like a lamb”: Republican and Democrat. His persona is the lamb, gentle, coming in peace, but “he spake as a dragon.”

“He exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: the first beast is Rome, and America upholds Greco Roman structure and culture. The Senate, the president, the architecture of the capital in DC, the Latin on the dollar bill, and last but not least Christianity, Roman Catholicism. White nationalism is Christianity.

“And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed”: we worship Rome. The days of the week have Roman names, the months of the year, the planets; the day beginning at midnight is Rome; Christmas is Rome, New Year’s is Rome, Easter is Rome.

“He doeth great wonders”: technology, scientific advancement. “So that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: the first atomic bomb, which they called the gadget, detonated in 1945 before they dropped two more on Japan, and after that the hydrogen bomb in 1952, which is worse. Nuclear technology making fire fall from heaven: those are the great wonders.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: by his technology he convinced the world that he is god, the main superpower on the earth, not the Most High. Oppenheimer understood what he had done: now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds. They even call it a wonder; they know the Bible is talking about it. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: in the sight of the other Europeans, the Germans and Russians, by power from Satan.

“Saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast”: around World War II the Head of Christ by Warner Sallman became the most circulated image almost in existence. It is a rendition of Cesare Borgia, the same face as the bust: white Jesus. The Borgias were the most corrupt crime family on the earth, and his sister Lucrezia posed as Mary. Nasty people.

“Which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: Rome, wounded by the sword, and yet it lived. It was revived in the Italian Renaissance, leading into the Renaissance.

precepts.why:
“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”: that other Jesus is Cesare Borgia, the image made to the beast. The apostles never preached him, because according to the Bible Christ is a black man.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received”: Christianity. “Or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”: the gospel that all nations can be saved, that the nations can become part of Israel, spiritual Israel, or that individual nations can get the kingdom and get glorified bodies. That is another gospel. That ain’t the Bible; that’s rainbow coalition, that’s democracy. It was not taught and not accepted back then.

“Take heed that no man deceive you”: going into Christianity. “For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ.” Coming in his name goes back to blaspheming his name: Revelation said the exact same thing.

Cesare Borgia said I am Christ. Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo painted Christ in a white image and said that is Christ from now on, “and shall deceive many”: throughout the world.

“For there shall arise false Christs”: the Head of Christ, Cesare Borgia, a false Christ. “And false prophets”: false teachers, missionaries, Jesuits, Christian pastors, ministers, Catholic priests, popes.

“And shall shew great signs and wonders”: Christian America, a Christian country, created the great wonders, nuclear war, fire falling down from heaven. These are the same wonders John saw the beast do.

“Insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” It is not possible. But his technological advancements, turning a man to a woman and a woman to a man, his science, his cars, televisions and phones, make him a god to our people. To them no one is better than him.

sense.text: “Hear ye the word which the Lord speaketh unto you, O house of Israel”: this is spoken to Israel, to us.

“Learn not the way of the heathen.” Our people worship this man and will follow tradition to the death, but the Bible says learn not the way of the heathen. “And be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them”: a shooting star, an eclipse, a full moon, a sunrise. The heathen are amazed at the things God made.

“For the customs of the people are vain”: that is why God says not to learn their ways. Then he elaborates on one custom: “for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.”

The new argument is that this is an idol carved out of a tree, not Christmas. But can you carve an idol with an axe? No. You use an axe to chop a tree down. The work of the workman with the axe is chopping it down out of the forest.

“They deck it with silver and with gold”: the it is the tree they chopped down in the forest, not an idol made out of it. They decorate the tree. Today they use gold and silver tinsel and sing songs like silver and gold; back then it was real gold and silver.

“They fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.” A tree cut down can’t stand on its own anymore; it isn’t on the stump. Today we call it a tree stand: you put the stump in the stand, pour water in it, and turn the screws so it can’t move. Same thing.

If it were a carved idol, it wouldn’t need to be nailed anywhere: you could carve it with three or four legs and it would stand on its own. Why nail it to the floor so it doesn’t move? Because it is the tree. Trees can’t stand on their own when you cut them down.

“They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not”: the heathen believed the tree would come to life and speak against you or attack you if you did not reward it or offer to it. Decking the tree was the custom, and if you didn’t deck it and reverence it, they said you would receive misfortune. “They must needs be borne, because they cannot go”: it can’t walk; it must be carried. “Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good”: it is not alive.

Upright as the palm tree: Jeremiah is prophesying against Babylon. On the stone relief from the throne room of Ashurnasirpal at Nimrud in northern Iraq, from about 870 BC (Nimrud is Nimrod, the first king of Babylon; Assyria reigned in Babylon, so Assyria and Babylon are the same thing), the king stands twice, on both sides of a sacred tree, in ritual robes, making a gesture of worship to a god in a winged disc above the tree: Ashur, their forefather Asshur deified as their national god, or Shamash, the god of the sun. Look at the tree: it is a palm tree. And what do you put on top of the tree in your house? A star, or an angel with wings. The same relief stood behind the king’s throne and all through their palaces. It is not an idol carved out of a tree; it is an actual tree they reverenced. The nations made their trees a tree of life, mimicking the garden of Eden, because trees live long, and they were deified for fertility and long life.

The tree of life of the Kabbalah, of rabbinical Judaism and Jewish mysticism, which is witchcraft, is the exact same design as the Assyrian sacred tree. That is not the tree of life at all; it is the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, Satan’s tree, the nations’ tree, because their god is the devil by default. Yggdrasil, the world tree of the Norse, Odin and Thor and Loki, is an example of the sacred trees and groves of Germanic paganism, which is where Christmas stems from. And the Egyptians brought palm fronds indoors at the winter solstice to celebrate the sun god Ra, whose name means evil, long before the Christmas tree came out of 16th century Germany. Christmas is at the solstice: sun worship. When you put that tree in your house, that is what you are following.

“But they are altogether brutish and foolish”: the heathen are brutish and foolish, and so are we for following them. “The stock is a doctrine of vanities.” The stock is a tree; in the Hebrew the word is ets, which means tree. The vanity is decorating it with silver and gold. People stop reading at verse five; you have to read the rest.

precepts.why:
“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit”: lest any man corrupt you, despoil you. It is a vain deceit because covetousness is behind it, a reward behind it: gifts. “After the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world”: the elements of the world, of man.

That is the same vanity Jeremiah names: “the customs of the people are vain.” The tree and its decking are a tradition of men and the rudiments of the world.

“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity.” The secret counsel of the wicked is the elite who sit back and research and study the ancient pagan cultures and incorporate them into our society today. Some call them Illuminati, some Luciferians: Bilderbergs, Duponts, Rothschilds. An elite group runs this world behind the scenes and works these customs into the norms we grew up in, and we reverence the customs of these elite demons as if they were God himself.

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily.” The snares are doctrines, religions, philosophies and politics; they commune, they hold their think tanks, to lay these snares for our people, whom they know are the real people of God. “They say, Who shall see them?” You don’t know a Luciferian if you meet one unless he tells you; they’re known, but they’re not known.

“They search out iniquities”: from the ancient mystic civilizations, Babylon, Assyria, Rome, Greece, Canaan, the Sidonians, Germanic and Norse folklore. “They accomplish a diligent search”: their archaeologists excavate and dig these things up, and then they revamp them, commercialize them and make them appealing and alluring to the foolish and ignorant. “Both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep”: they have all kinds of slick ways, TV, media, radio, propaganda, advertisement, music and fashion. Those are the signs and wonders in witchcraft. Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer, Jingle Bells: you have to check yourself, because it’s catchy.

That is the way of the heathen we are told not to learn: dug up from the old pagan nations and laid as a snare for Israel.

“Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught.” The apostles said hold the traditions you were taught. Who taught? The disciples. Did they teach Christmas? No. Birthdays? No. New Year’s, Thanksgiving, Mother’s Day, Halloween? No.

“Whether by word, or our epistle”: where are these holidays in their letters? Nowhere. A banger of a scripture; shout out to Captain Matthew, on point with it. Israel holds the traditions of the apostles, not the way of the heathen.

“Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.” Walking disorderly is walking against what we were taught. You out there celebrating Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year’s are celebrating the destruction of your own people. Saying ignorance is bliss for the sake of your family means celebrating the destruction of your family with your family. Make it make sense.

Read on: “But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing. And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.” If you are celebrating customs and traditions outside this text, you have to go, because you are an idolater. That is what it means.

sense.text:
Our commandment from our God was this: “ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves.” What is a grove? Trees. Cut them down. Why? Because they were sacred trees.

Most of the presidents, if not all of them, have visited the Bohemian Grove. The idol found in that grove is the owl, Molech, who is also on your dollar bill, real small; the god of wisdom. Everybody looks at the owl. Don’t focus on the owl: look at what surrounds it. Trees, so tall that all you see is the stock of the tree. The idol is under the tree.

precepts.why:
“Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods”: destroy the places where the nations served their gods. “Upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree.” Under every green tree: not some trees, every green tree. Evergreen, oak, cedar, palm, pine.

“And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire.” So today, if we were ruling, that owl would be destroyed and those trees all around it burned. Burn it all.

“They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms”: green trees. “Because the shadow thereof is good.” That owl sits under the shadow of those trees: the shadow is good because it is under the tree.

“Therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.” Around that owl at Bohemian Grove all kinds of sexual rituals take place. All the presidents went there, Obama included, whom so many of our people love; who knows what he was doing there.

“Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.”

Where were the sacrifices done? Under every green tree. The heathen sacrificed under the tree.

What is the sacrifice called? “If thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee; Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.”

The gift is the sacrifice. So when the heathen sacrificed under their tree, what was under the tree? Gifts. Gifts under the tree. There are so many directions to dismantle it, and none of them helps Christmas.

“Go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.” Moses commanded a gift: a sacrifice.

So when a heathen sacrificed under a tree, he offered gifts under the tree. You don’t put gifts on top of the tree, or beside the tree, or hang them on the tree. You put them under the tree. Where did you learn that from?

“Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks.” What were they doing under the tree? Slaying the children.

Those children were gifts too: gifts slain under the tree. That is why they use the children to allure us in all the most popular holidays, Halloween and Christmas. They use the kids.

sense.text:
“Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise.” You have technology; you have Google. You can easily look this up and see that it is pagan. But you are so covetous, wanting that self gratification: give me gifts. Thanksgiving gifts, Valentine’s Day gifts, New Year’s gifts, Halloween gifts, Christmas gifts, the Easter suit, your Sunday finest. It is always gifts.

“And stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove.” He knows it is wrong, he knows it is evil, but he won’t say anything; he will fight for it instead. Black and brown men will battle on Clubhouse for hours fighting for Christmas. Ask one question: are you a married man? Yes. So you’re scared to lose a vagina. Tell your wife today, babe, Christmas is pagan, we’re not celebrating it no more, and she will put a lock and key on that box and you’ll never see it again. The woman got you by the balls. She got your balls under the damn tree, gift wrapped. That’s the ordinance: you offered a gift.

“Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.” You can’t make Christmas good. It’s evil.

Santa Claus came to America from the Dutch: the 17th century Dutch settlers in New York, enslavers who killed the Native Americans, and the name Santa Claus is a corruption of their Sinterklaas. In the Netherlands they dress as Saint Nicholas with a black slave named Zwarte Piet, Black Pete, men in blackface, and Black Pete became the elves later on. He is the slaves of the Moors: when they conquered us, they celebrated it like this. Christmas in the Netherlands is a celebration of them enslaving us and making us their help. America gave Santa elves and reindeer instead of a negro slave, but they are still negroes, brown animals pulling a white man around. Bishop did a class on it years ago, the History of Christmas.

Saint Nicholas of Myra, who lived from 270 to 343 AD, was a black man, a Greek bishop in present day Turkey: the same black Greeks Paul wrote his letters to. When he walked the earth he was a kind man who gave gifts to the poor and to children, and the icons show him black, holding the Bible. Esau borrowed from him and whitewashed him. Only the whitewashed images of Saint Nicholas wear that hat. The Saint Nick they celebrate is not our black brother; he is used as a front. The figure is Pope Nicholas V, who wore that hat and who reigned from 1447 to 1455 and passed the edicts, Dum Diversas and Romanus Pontifex, to enslave our people throughout Africa and the colonies of Portugal and Spain and ship us over here. Black Pete is the proof: Pope Nicholas V is tied to Black Pete because he passed the edicts that made Black Pete. Out of that, nothing clean can come.

“In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us.” That is what we do at Christmas.

Look at the old Dutch images: the white ruffles around the neck and the ruffled sleeves on the little black boys standing by them, the same white ruffles the men in blackface wear today. They’re mocking us. Christmas is based upon mocking us while we were enslaved.

“And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant”: they had the Bible and forsook it. “And joined themselves to the heathen”: by following heathen customs and traditions. “And were sold to do mischief”: sold out to do mischief against their own people.

precepts.why:
“Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people”: that is America. “And every one should leave his laws”: leave our laws, our customs, the Bible. “So all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.”

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion.” The covenant with the heathen ends with Israelites consenting to the king’s religion, as our people consent to Christmas.

sense.text:
An old book, Tales Told in Holland, tells it: every winter the good old bishop Saint Nicholas comes in his ship over the sea from Spain, from Spain because they conquered us in Spain, and with him his servant, a little Moor named Black Pete, bringing goodies and toys for the little white children of Holland. If ever you see a little black boy, be careful how you treat him. The children know the saint has come by the rattling of chains outside, where in America it is the reindeer’s bells. Black Pete stands in the rear with an open sack for the naughty boys and girls and a rod to beat them: they made us the one who kidnaps children and beats them. They call Black Pete Krampus too, the evil Santa, the black monster. That’s us. In the old paintings the little black boy in the red hat holding a mirror for the white lady is the slave, the little black elf; they called us their favorites.

So when you celebrate that, this scripture is you: “ungodly persons, who hated their own people.” You celebrate Christmas, you despise your own people. It is clear cut: you are a supporter of white supremacy.

“In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves”: our job is to instruct those who oppose themselves, who hate themselves, who were taught customs that teach them to hate themselves ignorantly. That is our job today, doing this for you. “If God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth”: the truth of who the Israelites are according to the Bible, and that Christmas and all these customs are of Satan, as the Bible speaks of.

“And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil”: the snares the secret counsel of the wicked lay privily in Psalm 64. “Who are taken captive by him at his will”: our people are taken captive by the devil, the so-called white men, the Europeans, and his father the devil, and they follow his will by celebrating their own demise. Shalom, and an unmerry Christmas.
